name: model-gate
description: LLM API 中转网关：配置文件配置多家运营商模型，对外暴露统一 OpenAI 兼容接口

scripts.dev:api: MODEL_GATE_DEV=1 NODE_ENV=development bun scripts/ensure-admin-assets.ts && bun --watch src/index.ts
scripts.embed: bun install --cwd admin && bun run --cwd admin build && bun scripts/embed-assets.ts
scripts.build: bun run embed && bun build src/index.ts --target=bun --outfile model-gate.js
